children: US marine exploration equipment maker's fiscal Q2 revenue fell sharply yr/yr amid market softness
Company reported a wider net loss and negative adjusted EBITDA for fiscal Q2
After-market business contributed 87% of revenue, providing recurring income during order slowdown
Company says macro uncertainty is limiting near-term visibility and impacting order flow
Mind Technology sees timing of new projects as uncertain, tied to Middle East conflict resolution
Company maintains confidence in long-term marine exploration market fundamentals
MARKET SOFTNESS - Co said ongoing market softness and macro uncertainty limited order flow and visibility, impacting Q2 results
AFTER-MARKET REVENUE - After-market business contributed 87% of Q2 revenue, providing a recurring base during order slowdown
PROJECT DELAYS - Co said timing of new projects remains uncertain, with some customers waiting for resolution of Middle East conflict
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the oil related services and equipment peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Mind Technology Inc is $10.00, about 118.8% above its September 4 closing price of $4.57
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 22 three months ago
